description.narrative:
Goal <(>&<)> Strategic Objectives The primary goal of PWG-69 is to catalyze a paradigm shift in these livelihoods, moving from vulnerable subsistence farming to a resilient, profitable, circular bio-economy. ICED operate on the core philosophy that the Ecosystem is the primary Asset. Our objective is not simply to mitigate risk, but to prove that restoring natural capital (soil health, water quality) is the most intelligent and profitable long-term economic strategy.
Core Activities <(>&<)> Methodology Groundedin our "Applied Interdisciplinary Science" methodology, this is not a top-down intervention. Our approach is one of intensive co-creation and practical partnership.
Key activities will include: 1. Field-Validated Diagnostics: Deploying a rapid, interdisciplinary assessment(using FGDs, KIIs, and household surveys) to identify the specific technical, economic, and social barriers farmers face. 2. Co-Designed Circular Models: Developing "shovel-ready" intervention packages that are field-validated. This involves transforming on-farm "waste" (such as rice straw and shrimp wastewater) into high-value assets (such as bio-fertilizer and pathogen-free process water), effectively closing the loop. 3. Intensive "Hand-Holding": Providing practical, on-the-ground technical assistance and co-creation workshops to ensure farmers can master these new circular techniques, manage risk, and achieve tangible financial returns. 4. Market Access <(>&<)> Value Chain Integration: Connecting participating farmers to high-value, sustainable markets that recognize and reward high-quality, eco-certified products.
Project Scope <(>&<)> Beneficiaries Project Area: Four communes (Hồng Dân, Ninh Quới, Vĩnh Lộc và Ninh Thạnh Lợi) in Ca Mau province, Vietnam. Duration: 18 months (commencing November 2025). Target Beneficiaries: Smallholder shrimp-rice farming households.
=> Over its 18-month duration, PWG-69 will deliver a proven, scalable, and economically convincing model for a climate-resilient Vietnamese Mekong Delta.

participating-org.narrative:
The ICED at Vietnam National University – Ho Chi Minh City (VNU-HCM) was established on February 23, 2020, with its launching day on July 2, 2020. ICED is positioned as a leading institute for the Circular Economy (CE) in Vietnam and the Global South, aiming to provide knowledge, solutions about technologies, innovation, and policies related to CE. It acts as a platform linking government, industry, and academia for sustainable development.
ICED's mission is to provide practical socio-technological solutions, innovations, and policy support on the circular economy in Vietnam and to link Vietnam's CE to the world. Its core values are Pioneer, Partnership, and Practicality, with the slogan: "Circularity Mindset for Sustainable Growth."
The ICED focuses on key research themes, including CE solutions for cities and industrial zones, bio-economy in agriculture and forestry, solutions for coastal regions and islands, and emerging topics like plastic waste and renewable energy. It is actively involved in projects, publications, and policy recommendations, collaborating with various national and international partners.
